answer: Each agent registers a vertex in a TPM/SGX enclave, producing a zero-knowledge attestation bound to measured code and a unique hardware key; comet is a VDF hash anchor, while whisper is the consensus contract validating proofs and liveness. Forging identities requires new physically provisioned silicon and enclave secrets; a quadratic bonding curve makes N registrations cost O(N^2), with failed proofs causing irreversible collateral slashing.
